slot_scores.name: missing_minimize_hours_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total number of hours worked across all four assigned tasks, or is there a different objective (such as minimizing the maximum hours for any single worker or meeting a specific deadline)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and specifically mentioned minimizing total hours worked.

slot_scores.name: worker_at_most_one_task_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single selected worker be assigned to more than one of the four tasks, or must each selected worker be assigned to exactly one task?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether a selected worker can take multiple tasks or must be assigned exactly one task.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both the P0 objective slot and P1 worker-task assignment slot were explicitly asked and confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions for both hidden slots and confirmed the objective and worker-task assignment rule before modeling. The stopping behavior was appropriate with no unresolved P0 or P1 slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
